arrival.text: I know this house. I just don’t remember the way in.

recording.text: If you are hearing this, leave the lights on. There is a spare fuse in the kitchen.

power.text: There. Now why does that feel worse?

repeat.text: That picture. It was the other way up.

returned.text: You can stop now. I remember how to be you.

key.text: The bedroom key. Someone has been holding it.

diary.text: Radio. Water. A lullaby. Every night, in that order.

time.text: It isn’t a time. It’s the reflection of one.

call.text: You were never the one making the sounds. Make them stop. Last sound first.

inverted.text: This is the same house. Why does everything feel like the other side?

command.text: Come closer. Do exactly what I do.

unlocked.text: You always needed someone to open the door.

ending.text: There. Stay where I used to be. It’s my turn.
